verdict.rationale: Firestore offers a MongoDB-compatible API that works with existing MongoDB drivers, tools and integrations, so standard clients can connect. That support is limited to the Firestore Enterprise edition, and the default Firestore and Realtime Database are reached only through Firebase SDKs. Missing for 10: support outside the Enterprise edition, explicit documentation of connection-string access, evidence of ORM/ODM compatibility such as Mongoose, and independent or hands-on confirmation that drivers work.
